product_one_liner.value: Levitate is an AI-powered relationship-marketing platform that helps small businesses manage contacts and send personalized email, text, and social-media outreach to clients, prospects, and referral sources.

pricing_page.notes: The public plans page describes the platform, included services, and optional add-ons.

hq_location.notes: Headquarters listed as Raleigh, North Carolina.

eng_blog.notes: The Real Talk index presents marketing, small-business, and product-update content rather than an engineering blog.

public_docs.notes: Public help-center articles cover product usage, AI assistants, and the MCP server.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The five listed openings are Revenue Insights Coordinator, three Sales Development Representative positions, and Manager, Account Executive; none has a qualifying AI/ML title.

model_provider.notes: The underlying-model provider list, updated June 12, 2026, names Anthropic PBC, Google LLC, and OpenAI, LLC; the company story explicitly mentions Claude.

compliance_certs.notes: Public claims include SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, and PCI DSS SAQ A.

last_funding.notes: Announced March 5, 2026. The company reports $16 million; PitchBook classifies the round as Series E and reports $15.9 million.

raised_18mo.notes: The March 5, 2026 funding announcement falls within the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The Raleigh Sales Development Representative posting has an active application form.
